prompt: The volunteer called the family and (say / tell) them that their lost tabby cat was safe near the station.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат (them) без предлога to.

prompt: The street sweeper (say / tell) to the commuter that the central square was closed for a marathon.
explanation_ru: Глагол say используется перед предлогом to (said to the commuter).

prompt: Maya messaged the group chat and (say / tell) that she had burnt the marinade and was bringing store-bought sauce instead.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не требует прямого дополнения (адресата) перед придаточным предложением с that.

prompt: When the customs officer asked about the thirty identical wooden spoons, the traveler (say / tell) him they were wedding favors.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует указания собеседника (him) сразу после себя без предлога.

prompt: During lunch, the technician (say / tell) us a funny story about accidentally locking himself inside the freezing vault.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое сочетание tell a story (рассказать историю) требует глагола tell.

prompt: He called his parents just before boarding to (say / tell) them that his flight was delayed by three hours.
explanation_ru: После tell сразу следует местоимение them (кому сообщили) без предлога to.

prompt: Sitting at the corner table, they whispered and (say / tell) that the giant chocolate cake actually came from a supermarket.
explanation_ru: После глагола say не указан адресат, сразу идёт придаточное предложение с that.

prompt: The host apologized and (say / tell) the couple that their dinner reservation was canceled because the kitchen had flooded.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell прямо указывается кому сообщили (the couple) без предлога.

prompt: The girl admitted she had lost her glasses on a roller coaster and begged the optician not to (say / tell) her dad.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу следует прямое дополнение (her dad) без предлога to.

prompt: After a storm exposed old wooden beams in the cliff, the walker left a note that (say / tell) where the museum team could find them.
explanation_ru: О записке или знаке с текстом используется глагол say (a note that said...).

prompt: During breakfast, the ski rep (say / tell) everyone that heavy snow had closed the main lift for the morning.
explanation_ru: После tell сразу ставится указание на слушателей (everyone) без предлога.

prompt: Over coffee, Clara finally (say / tell) the truth about applying for the manager position that both of them wanted.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение tell the truth (сказать правду) всегда употребляется с глаголом tell.

prompt: Two restorers were carefully cleaning a dark landscape painting in the studio. Suddenly, Elena (say / tell) her colleague to look closely at the bottom corner. She (say / tell) that a small painted dog had been hidden under layers of old varnish for centuries.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется tell + адресат + to-инфинитив (told her colleague to look), во втором — say перед придаточным с that без адресата.

prompt: Backstage after the concert, Leo looked nervous. He (say / tell) his partner that he had accidentally unplugged the keyboard right before the solo. Both stagehands agreed not to (say / tell) a word about the mistake to the band.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске после tell идёт адресат (his partner); во втором — устойчивое выражение say a word (проронить ни слова).

prompt: A colorful poster was hanging near the school entrance this morning. The notice (say / tell) that auditions for the winter play will happen in the main hall next Tuesday. Our drama teacher also (say / tell) us to bring a short monologue.
explanation_ru: О тексте объявления говорится с помощью say (the notice said/says); во втором случае использована конструкция tell + us + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Right before chemistry grading, Nadia looked at the ruined crystals in the beaker. She (say / tell) that she had accidentally mixed the wrong salt into their week-long experiment. Then she (say / tell) her lab partner she would explain everything to the professor.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске нет указания адресата, поэтому нужен say; во втором указан собеседник (her lab partner), поэтому используется tell.

prompt: While pouring hot tea at the sideline table, the volunteer asked why the match had paused. The scorer laughed and (say / tell) her that a stray dog had run off with the spare ball. He (say / tell) it was the funniest interruption of the season.
explanation_ru: В первом случае после tell стоит местоимение her (кому сказали), во втором случае адресат не указан, поэтому используется say.

prompt: A neighbor posted an urgent warning in our building group chat today. The message (say / tell) that a fake delivery app link is circulating and stealing passwords. She (say / tell) everyone not to click on unknown links.
explanation_ru: О содержании сообщения используется say (the message said/says); во втором предложении tell употребляется с адресатом everyone и инфинитивом.

prompt: Using the bus microphone, the tour assistant ___ the passengers about a sudden detour due to a fallen tree.
explanation_ru: Конструкция tell someone about something требует глагола tell, так как сразу указан адресат (the passengers) без предлога.

prompt: At the airport duty-free shop, the traveler whispered and ___ that he had forgotten his wife's birthday.
explanation_ru: Перед придаточным предложением с that без указания собеседника используется только глагол said.

prompt: The kitchen assistant phoned the manager early in the morning to ___ him that someone had left the freezer door open all night.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится прямое дополнение him без предлога to.

prompt: In her weekly email, she ___ her parents that she watches the northern lights from her cabin window almost every night.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell используется без предлога перед адресатом (told her parents).

prompt: A resident posted a message online and told that a fox was seen near the back gardens last night.
answer: A resident posted a message online and said that a fox was seen near the back gardens last night.
accepted_answers: A resident posted a message online and said that a fox was seen near the back gardens last night.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell обязательно нужно указать кому сообщили; без адресата используется said.

prompt: A listener phoned the radio station and said the host about a giant pothole on High Street.
answer: A listener phoned the radio station and told the host about a giant pothole on High Street.
accepted_answers: A listener phoned the radio station and told the host about a giant pothole on High Street.
explanation_ru: В конструкции «сообщить кому-то о чём-то» без предлога to используется told (told the host about), а не said.

prompt: The shopkeeper told the delivery driver that three boxes of apples had disappeared from the back alley.
answer: The shopkeeper told the delivery driver that three boxes of apples had disappeared from the back alley.
accepted_answers: The shopkeeper told the delivery driver that three boxes of apples had disappeared from the back alley.
explanation_ru: Предложение построено верно: после глагола told сразу указан собеседник (the delivery driver) без предлога.

prompt: My sister called me excitedly and said me that she had finally passed her driving test on the fourth try.
answer: My sister called me excitedly and told me that she had finally passed her driving test on the fourth try.
accepted_answers: My sister called me excitedly and told me that she had finally passed her driving test on the fourth try.
My sister called me excitedly and said to me that she had finally passed her driving test on the fourth try.
explanation_ru: Нельзя говорить «said me» без предлога to; правильно использовать «told me».

prompt: The baker steps out to the morning queue to announce that fresh apple strudel has just come out of the oven. Which sentence is correct?
options: The baker said the customers that fresh apple strudel was ready.
The baker told the customers that fresh apple strudel was ready.
The baker told to the customers that fresh apple strudel was ready.
The baker said that fresh apple strudel was ready to the customers.
explanation_ru: Правильная модель — tell + адресат без предлога (told the customers that...).

prompt: A mother calls the family clinic during a heavy snowstorm to cancel a routine checkup. Which sentence is correct?
options: She said the nurse that she could not drive in the snow.
She told to the nurse that she could not drive in the snow.
She told the nurse that she could not drive in the snow.
She told that she could not drive in the snow.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует прямого дополнения (the nurse) сразу после себя без предлога to.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'told' instead of 'said to': He phoned the curator and said to him that he had found a gold Roman coin under an old apple tree.
answer: He phoned the curator and told him that he had found a gold Roman coin under an old apple tree.
accepted_answers: He phoned the curator and told him that he had found a gold Roman coin under an old apple tree.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «said to him» заменяется на «told him» без предлога to.
